Subject: MAP + proposed close cadence for Biocorp pilot — MSA/DPA sequencing

Hi Elaine —

Great to meet (virtually) last week. Following up with a pragmatic mutual action plan (attached) that sequences the MSA, DPA and order form so we can meet your pilot start target while keeping legal review bounded. Highlights in the MAP_v3.xlsx: 

- Week 1 (5/14–5/20): procurement intake + Biocorp legal redlines (target: consolidated redlines)
- Week 2 (5/21–5/27): Redwood responds to redlines; SOC2 evidence bundle shared; order form finalized
- Week 3 (5/28–6/3): sign MSA/DPA/order form (target signature week 5/31)

Two specific asks for your team to confirm:
1) Is Biocorp comfortable with a single-signature cadence (MSA + DPA + order form on same day)?
2) Any firm blackout dates before 5/31 that will block approvers?

I attached the MAP_v3.xlsx and a draft list of artifacts we will deliver (SOC2 evidence, onboarding checklist). I also attached our current redline starter (Draft_MSA_redlines_20290515.pdf) so your lawyers can see our starting position.

If it helps, we can do a 20-min alignment call tomorrow to walk the timeline and lock approvers. Proposed times: 10:00–10:30 PT or 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Strategic Accounts 
Redwood Inference

- We received the MAP but need a consolidated list of acceptance criteria tied to the order form (can you add an "Acceptance" tab to the MAP?).

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: internal — note on fallback model + SLA carveouts

Rachel / Karthik — quick internal note before we send updated MAP to Biocorp: 

- If Biocorp insists on a shorter retention window than our standard, we should propose a scoped DPA appendix limiting retention for pilot data only (timebox 90 days post-pilot) rather than a global policy change.
- For SLA, recommend we keep the standard 99.9% for the dedicated pool but add a pilot SLA exception: credits apply only after 2 consecutive degraded days (helps avoid churn on a short pilot).
- Confirm that we can include the SOC2 bundle (non-prod artifacts removed) in Biocorp_SOC2_evidence.zip — I will validate with security.

If all good, I will greenlight the updated attachments and Rachel can send to Elaine/Rajiv.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

2) Redwood to respond with counter-redlines by 5/23;
3) Procurement final review 5/24–5/27;
4) Target signature date: 2029-05-31 (MSA + DPA + order form executed same day).

If you prefer we can stage the signature (order form first, then MSA/DPA), but our preference is single-sign to avoid misalignment on acceptance windows.

Links: HubSpot record for the deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/biocorp) and the shared MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_MAP_v3).

Thanks — Rachel
